# Rule options

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_config_docs.py from proto/vartrack/v1/models/rule.proto. Edit the comments there, then run the tool. -->

Every option a rule can have, and where it may be set. A rule is built from up to three files, each laid over the one before ([how](index.md#how-a-rule-is-built)): `config.cue`, the tenant's `bundle.json`, and the pushed repository's `vartrack.json`; then `config.cue`'s `force` block.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **config.cue** | The rule in the bundle every service reads. Every option can be set here. |
| **bundle.json** | The tenant's layer, in its schema repository. An option only `config.cue` sets is dropped from it with a warning. |
| **vartrack.json** | The repository's layer. Any other option there is ignored and logged. |
| **Across layers** | What happens when two layers set the option. |

| Option | Type | config.cue | bundle.json | vartrack.json | Across layers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`platform`](#platform) | string | yes | names the rule | — | names the rule (with `platform`/`datasource`): not changed by a layer |
| [`datasource`](#datasource) | string | yes | names the rule | — | names the rule (with `platform`/`datasource`): not changed by a layer |
| [`repositories`](#repositories) | list | yes | — | — | only `config.cue` sets it |
| [`file_name`](#file_name) | string | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`file_path_map`](#file_path_map) | object (string → string) | yes | yes | yes | merged key by key |
| [`branch`](#branch) | string | yes | yes | — | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`root_key`](#root_key) | string | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`branch_as_env`](#branch_as_env) | boolean | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`pr_as_env`](#pr_as_env) | boolean | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`tag_as_env`](#tag_as_env) | boolean | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`branch_map`](#branch_map) | object (string → string) | yes | yes | yes | merged key by key |
| [`secret_manager`](#secret_manager) | string | yes | — | — | only `config.cue` sets it |
| [`destination_template`](#destination_template) | string | yes | yes | — | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`variables_map`](#variables_map) | object (string → string) | yes | yes | yes | merged key by key |
| [`sync_mode`](#sync_mode) | string: `AUTO`, `GIT_UPSERT_ALL`, `GIT_SMART_REPAIR`, `LIVE_STATE` | yes | yes | yes | the upper layer replaces it |
| [`exclude_repositories`](#exclude_repositories) | list | yes | — | — | only `config.cue` sets it |
| [`overrides`](#overrides) | list | yes | — | — | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `platform`

The platform that sends this rule's pushes: a platforms entry's name, "github", "gitea", or "{type}-{tag}" for a tagged one. With datasource it names the rule: a bundle.json rule layers the config.cue rule with the same platform and datasource, and there is at most one of each pair.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | names the rule (with `platform`/`datasource`): not changed by a layer |

## `datasource`

Where the rule writes: a datasources entry's name, "mongo", "redis", or "{type}-{tag}" for a tagged one ("mongo-billing").

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | names the rule (with `platform`/`datasource`): not changed by a layer |

## `repositories`

The repositories whose pushes this rule syncs, as "owner/name" glob patterns ("acme/*", "acme/payments-*"). The gateway routes a push by them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `file_name`

Explicit single file to track in every repository. Mutually exclusive with file_path_map (validated below).

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `file_path_map`

```text
Maps environment label → file path for per-env config files.
e.g. { "production": "config/prod.json", "staging": "config/staging.json" }
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | object (string → string) |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | merged key by key |

## `branch`

The rule's own branch: it feeds the file_path_map environments, and it is the branch the periodic self-heal compares when the rule has no branch_map (with a branch_map, every branch in it is healed). "main" when unset.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `root_key`

Top-level key to extract from the parsed file BEFORE flattening. Only that subtree is written to the sink.

```text
Default behaviour (field absent or unset):
  → "vartrack" is used as the key.
  → If the file contains a "vartrack" key, only that section is synced.
  → If "vartrack" is absent, the WHOLE FILE is used (soft fallback).
```

Set to "" to always process the entire file regardless of its contents.

```text
Examples:
  root_key: "properties"  → sync only the "properties" object
  root_key: "vartrack"    → (default) sync "vartrack" section or whole file
  root_key: ""            → always sync whole file
```

Works the same way for every supported format (JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, .env, .properties, HCL, INI, JS module): the key is looked up after the file is parsed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `branch_as_env`

The branch name is the environment. Formerly env_as_branch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |
| Former names | `env_as_branch` — still read, with a warning |

## `pr_as_env`

"pr-{number}" is the environment. Formerly env_as_pr.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |
| Former names | `env_as_pr` — still read, with a warning |

## `tag_as_env`

The tag name is the environment. Formerly env_as_tags. The former names are still read from bundles and vartrack.json.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |
| Former names | `env_as_tags` — still read, with a warning |

## `branch_map`

```text
Branch → environment, e.g. {main: "production", develop: "staging"}.
A push to a branch that is not listed, and that no file_path_map,
branch_as_env, pr_as_env or tag_as_env places, feeds no environment of
the rule: it is skipped, not written anywhere. There is no "default"
environment; a rule has to name where its environments come from (this,
file_path_map, branch_as_env, pr_as_env or tag_as_env) in config.cue or the
tenant's bundle.json, or it is refused when it is loaded. To keep writing
to an environment called default, map a branch to it: {main: "default"}.
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | object (string → string) |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | merged key by key |

## `secret_manager`

The secret manager (a secret_managers entry: "vault" or "vault-{tag}") that {ref: …} credentials of this rule's platform and datasource, and its @secret() fields, are read from. Unset: the entry tagged "default", else the bundle's only one.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `destination_template`

Universal storage path / key / name template for the sink. Supported placeholders: {tenant}, {env}

```text
Sink        Interpretation               Example
zookeeper   znode root path              "/{tenant}/{env}"  → /acme/pr-42
s3          S3 key prefix                "{tenant}/{env}"   → acme/pr-42/config.json
redis       key prefix                   "{tenant}:{env}"   → acme:pr-42:vartrack
mongo       collection name              "{env}-config"     → pr-42-config
linux       full file path               "/etc/app/{env}/config.env"
helm        release name                 "app-{env}"        → app-pr-42
configmap   ConfigMap name               "myapp-{env}"      → myapp-pr-42
```

When not set each sink falls back to its own sink-specific config key.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |
| Former names | `zk_path_template` — still read, with a warning |

## `variables_map`

Renames of flat keys before they are written: {"NEW_NAME": "path.in.file"} writes the value at path.in.file under NEW_NAME.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | object (string → string) |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | merged key by key |

## `sync_mode`

How a sync writes. AUTO (the default) uses GIT_UPSERT_ALL for a file of up to 500 keys and GIT_SMART_REPAIR above. GIT_UPSERT_ALL writes every key. GIT_SMART_REPAIR reads what the sink holds and writes only what differs, by content: the changed keys in Redis, ZooKeeper and MongoDB key-value, and in a sink that holds the file as one object (a MongoDB document, an S3 object, a file, a ConfigMap, a Helm values file or release) the whole file, or nothing when it already holds the file. If the sink cannot be read, every key is written. LIVE_STATE is written like GIT_UPSERT_ALL. The proto names (SYNC_MODE_AUTO, ...) are read too, and FULL as GIT_UPSERT_ALL.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string: `AUTO`, `GIT_UPSERT_ALL`, `GIT_SMART_REPAIR`, `LIVE_STATE` |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `exclude_repositories`

Repositories (glob patterns) this rule skips although repositories matches them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `overrides`

Turns the rule on or off for some repositories: [{match_repositories: ["other-org/*"], enable: true}].

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `prune`

Delete keys varTrack wrote before that Git no longer holds: true, or {enabled, protection}. Prune runs once per environment after all its files are written, only on sinks that keep each key separately (Redis, ZooKeeper, MongoDB with STRATEGY_KEY_VALUE). A key changed outside varTrack is kept and reported. protection lists glob patterns of keys that are never deleted; every layer's patterns add up. An object with only protection does not turn pruning on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean, or object (`enabled`, `protection`) |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | merged key by key; `protection` patterns add up |

## `self_heal`

The watcher compares the datasource with Git on every poll and, on drift, has the orchestrator write Git's values back.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `force`

Rule keys pinned by this bundle. The orchestrator builds the rule it syncs with in layers, each overriding the one before: this rule, the schema repo's bundle.json rule for the same platform and datasource, the repo's vartrack.json, and last these keys, e.g. force: {prune: {enabled: false}}. Keys only the bundle sets (connection settings, secrets, repositories, self_heal, ...) are not needed here and are ignored.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | object |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `tenants`

The tenants whose bundle.json may layer this rule: any tenant when empty. When no tenant's bundle.json names the rule, the first one owns it ("default" when empty).

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue` |
| Across layers | only `config.cue` sets it |

## `suspend`

Pauses automatic syncs: pushes and self-heal skip the rule, while syncs started by hand (web UI, vt) still run, so a pause does not block a deliberate sync.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `drift_ignore`

Keys (glob patterns) a drift check does not compare: keys the application changes itself.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `strict_validation`

A file the CUE schema rejects fails the sync instead of being written with a warning. Without it a failed validation is logged and the file is still synced.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json`, `vartrack.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `schema_map`

Which schema checks which file, by the file's path in its repository: the first entry whose `match` matches the path wins. Without a match the schema is found by the file's name (`<name>.cue`, then `default.cue`) as before. A schema the map names that is not in the schema repository fails the file, with or without strict_validation. The layers add up, config.cue's entries first, so a path the operator mapped cannot be remapped by a tenant.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `schema_from_file`

Let a JSON, YAML or TOML file name its own schema with a top-level `$schema` key, when no schema_map entry matched its path (the map wins, and the file's result says so). The value has the syntax of a schema_map `schema`; a URL (an editor's hint) is ignored. `$schema` is never synced as a key, whether this is on or not.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `repo_url`

HTTPS clone URL of the config repository. Left out, it is derived from the platform and the rule's only repository.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `key_format`

How a nested key is flattened into a flat destination key: "dot", "flat", …

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `file_format`

Linux server: the format the file is written in. Left out, the file's extension.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `env_as_filename`

Linux server: one file per environment, named after it. True when left out.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `helm_values_mode`

Helm: how values reach the chart, "set" (--set flags) or "file".

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

S3: tags put on every object written.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | object (string → string) |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |

## `s3_tag_keys`

S3: keys whose values become object tags.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Set in | `config.cue`, `bundle.json` |
| Across layers | the upper layer replaces it |
